slots.title: Crypto Long & Short: Crypto exchanges shouldn’t double as the vault
slots.author: CoinDesk
slots.summary: A single breach moved billions out of Binance in minutes, exposing how much client money sits with the venue that trades it. Darren Jordan of Komainu argues institutions should keep trading and custody separate, as traditional markets have for decades, and sets out the questions

slots.summary: Prosecutors estimate the defendant still holds 56,000 BTC, meaning the proposed deal would leave him with roughly $1 billion.
